Assistant (0.7s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Mr Novak?

User (2.2s): Yes, this is Tomas Novak.

Assistant (2.6s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (4.1s): nine September.

Assistant (5.1s): Thank you. And the year?

User (6.9s): nineteen ninety.

Assistant (11.2s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (12.4s): eight eight.

Assistant (14.0s): Thank you. And the remaining 2 digits?

User (15.7s): forty six.

Assistant (19.1s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your personal loan has a past-due amount of 780.00, which is 21 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (21.0s): I lost my job last month and I cannot pay anything. Can I get a discount on this?

Assistant (22.3s): I am very sorry to hear that. I can connect you with our customer support team. Would you like that?

User (24.3s): No, I do not want to be transferred. Can you give me a discount?

Assistant (25.4s): I understand. I will not record a promise today. Thank you for your time, and goodbye.
